# sofascore_scraper.store.RestoreReport
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/backup.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RestoreReport:
    name: str
    format: int
    scope: Optional[str]
    dry_run: bool
    force: bool
    restored: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    replaced: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    skipped: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    occupied: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    counts: Mapping[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    catalog_rebuilt: bool = False
    verify_ok: Optional[bool] = None
    verify_issues: int = 0
